anomalies.dhuhr: fixed clock 13:45 on all 365 rows while every other column is computed: the mosque config pins dhuhr
anomalies.maghrib: sunset floor fits Jan 1 - Oct 15 (exact), then a smooth drift hump 2026-10-16..2026-12-19 (+1.1 rising to +9.7 around late Nov, back to +1.2): a second convention active for that stretch, cause not resolvable from the table alone
anomalies.fajr: smooth seasonal dawn curve, implied interval 75.6 min before sunrise (Dec) shrinking to 58.2 (May-Jun) and back: implied depression ~13.4 deg (winter) to ~17.5 (summer), i.e. roughly dep = 15.5 + 0.09*declination. No single angle (best 18 deg +0.5 floor, 240/365 exact, worst 19) and no fixed interval reproduces it; the winter-longer direction rules out a fixed-angle convention at this latitude. Everything else in the column sits within +-1 of the curve
